verdict.rationale: Sentry's official self-hosted docs say you can "run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything" and that Sentry maintains a minimal out-of-the-box setup. Community users confirm long-running self-hosted deployments are "rock-solid," though others report heavy resource use, and self-hosted releases trail SaaS. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the self-hosted install and operations docs, a lighter-weight deployment path (the minimal setup targets simple use cases and grows resource-hungry), and parity timing with SaaS releases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.
Sentry offers and maintains a minimal setup that works out-of-the-box for simple use cases.

A user who has run self-hosted Sentry at work for a couple of years, and the SaaS product for freelance work, said it has "worked fantastically" and is "rock-solid once running, I never worry about it."
